Our Mission

The internet is saturated with low-resolution video loops, distracting advertisements, and commercial myths about sacred geometry. Sri Yantra Meditation was created to offer an uncompromising, authentic digital sanctuary.

We set out to engineer three foundational pillars:

  1. Sub-Pixel Mathematical Precision: Rendering the 9 primary triangles, 43 formed polygons, and 24 lotus petals using precision Canvas 2D vectors that resolve the ancient Concurrency Problem without line distortion or overlapping slivers.
  2. Pure Procedural Web Audio: Real-time synthesis of the 136.10 Hz Cosmic Octave (Earth orbital frequency) and Tanpura string overtones entirely inside your browser—eliminating choppy audio loops or high-bandwidth audio streaming.
  3. Distraction-Free Immersion: Built with the W3C Screen Wake Lock API to ensure your meditation is never interrupted by a dimming screen, combined with auto-hiding controls that fade out to leave only the glowing sacred geometry.

100% Client-Side Privacy Guarantee

Zero Telemetry • Zero Trackers

Your meditation is personal and sacred. This application runs entirely inside your browser. We do not use third-party tracking scripts, cookies, or analytics beacons. Audio synthesis and graphic rendering happen strictly on your device's GPU and CPU.
